units.source_text: 本来我还有话要对夫人说，可是又担心被夫人看成是个爱争论的人，便克制住自己，

en.t: I still had something I wanted to say to his wife, but I was afraid she would take me for someone who loved to argue, so I held myself back,

units.source_text: 盯着喝干的茶杯不再言语了。夫人怕慢待了我，

en.t: and, staring at my empty teacup, fell silent. Afraid that she had been neglecting me,

units.source_text: 便说道：“再喝一杯吧。”

en.t: she said, "Would you like another cup?"

units.source_text: 我马上把茶杯递给她。

en.t: I immediately handed her my teacup.

units.source_text: “要几块？一块，还是两块？”

en.t: "How many lumps? One, or two?"

units.source_text: 夫人很灵巧地捏了一块方糖，望着我的脸问道。

en.t: His wife deftly picked up a lump of sugar and asked while looking at my face.

units.source_text: 她的表情虽说不上是向我献媚，却充满了想要缓和刚才的生硬态度的娇媚。

en.t: Her expression was not quite coquettish toward me, but it was full of a charm that seemed meant to soften the stiffness of her attitude a moment before.

units.source_text: 我默默地喝着茶，喝完了还是一声不响。

en.t: I drank my tea in silence, and even after I had finished, I said nothing.

units.source_text: “怎么一下子这么沉默了？”夫人问。

en.t: "Why have you suddenly gone so quiet?" his wife asked.

units.source_text: “一说话就会挨说，显得特别喜欢争论似的。”我答道。

en.t: "Whenever I say anything, I get scolded, as if I were especially fond of arguing," I replied.

units.source_text: “怎么会啊。”夫人又说。

en.t: "Surely not," his wife said again.

units.source_text: 借着这个话头，我和夫人又聊了起来，

en.t: Taking that as an opening, his wife and I began talking again,

units.source_text: 聊的还是两个人都感兴趣的先生。

en.t: and our subject was once more Sensei, who interested us both.

units.source_text: “夫人，可以让我再接着刚才的话往下说吗？

en.t: "Madam, may I continue what I was saying earlier?

units.source_text: 在您听来也许是强词夺理，可我并不是毫无根据地信口胡说。”

en.t: It may sound like forced reasoning to you, but I am not just talking nonsense without any basis."

units.source_text: “那你就说吧。”

en.t: "Then go ahead and say it."

units.source_text: “如果夫人突然不在了，先生能像现在这样活下去吗？”

en.t: "If you were suddenly gone, could Sensei go on living as he does now?"

units.source_text: “我怎么能知道啊，你呀，这种事只能去问先生，不该来问我呀。”

en.t: "How could I know that? You should ask Sensei about such things, not me."

units.source_text: “夫人，我可不是开玩笑，您不要回避，您一定要诚实回答。”

en.t: "Madam, I am not joking. Please do not evade the question. You must answer honestly."

units.source_text: “是诚实的呀，说实在的，我不知道啊。”

en.t: "I am being honest. To tell the truth, I do not know."

units.source_text: “那么，您有多爱先生呢？

en.t: "Then how much do you love Sensei?

units.source_text: 这个问题与其问先生，不如问您吧。”

en.t: This is a question better asked of you than of Sensei."
